title: 966 collaboration controller
body:
Fixes #966 

Develop controller class to contain logic associated with Collaborative Editing

issues.title: Testable Controller for collaborative working
issues.body:
As a maintainer I want to put `collaborative editing` into testable controller.

There is quite a lot of functionality in collaborative data editing.

It would be easier to test this if it was in pure code.

To include:
* [x] configure controller using channel details
* [x] for current role, which template(s) are available?  (empty for none)
* [x] for current role, am I participating in this channel?
* [x] for current role, can I view channel as an observer? 
* [x] for current role, can I release a message?
* [x] for current force, can I see in-progress changes?
* [x] for current role, what commands are displayed for message of this state?
* [x] for current role, can I see this message? (test for unallocated, allocated, released)
* [x] who can have messages in this channel assigned to them?
* [x] what is initial state for this new message?
* [ ] apply this command to this message
